this message ) ( Learn how and when to remove this message ) Podcast A Folk Song A Day Boden in one of the logos Genre Folk music , Music podcast Language English Publication No. of episodes 365 Original release 24 June 2010 ( 2010-06-24 ) – 24 June 2011 ( 2011-06-24 ) Updates Daily Related Website https://www.afolksongaday.com/ A Folk Song a Day was a project by the English folk singer and musician and Bellowhead member [ 1 ] Jon Boden where he recorded and released a folk song each day for one year. [ 2 ] The project ended on 24 June 2011. About [ edit ] The project started on 24 June 2010. [ 3 ] It has resulted in 12 digital albums (one for each month). [ 4 ] Boden hopes that it will promote social singing and be a resource for those looking for inspiration. [ 5 ] The songs can be bought in the form of digital download from Amazon or from iTunes. [ 6 ] The project reached number one in the iTunes music podcast in its first week. [ 7 ] The songs [ edit ] A Folk Song A Day 1: July

culture [ edit ] Jon Boden's A Folk Song A Day has inspired other spinoffs, most notably the Australian Folk Song A Day project featuring 367 folk renditions on a daily basis between 26 January 2011 and 26 January 2012 by John Thompson. [ 8 ] Other similar projects include Fifty-Two Folk Songs , [ 9 ] Oli Steadman 's 365 Days Of Folk , [ 10 ] and a A Liverpool Folk Song a Week .
